Example 2
Write each of the following in word form.
a. 305.183 | b, 84,005 | «3,024.8
Solution (®)
a. Three hundred five and one hundred eighty-three thousandths.
b. Eighty-four and five thousandths.
c. Three thousand, twenty-four and eight tenths.
Example 3
In the number 6,354.792
a. Whatis the value of 6? b. Whatis the value of 2?
c, What does the digit 4 represent ?
d. Whatis the value of the digit in the Hundredth place ?
Solution [%]
a. 6,000 b, 0.002 c. 4Ones d. 0.09
Notes for parents :
+ Help your child read and write decimal numbers to the Thousandths place.
